snippet.title: SPACETIME CHRONICLES — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A surreal paper stop-motion feature film by Stefano Bertelli.

SPACETIME CHRONICLES follows Fred, a man suspended between reality, dreams and limbo, guided by Freud — a mysterious cat who acts as his conscience.

From claustrophobic school corridors and missed encounters to visionary landscapes and cryptic conversations, Fred confronts his fears, desires and unresolved memories in a journey through the fragmented landscape of his own mind.

A handcrafted animated film created with paper, combining stop-motion animation, surreal imagery and existential storytelling.

Written & Directed by Stefano Bertelli
Set Design: Riccardo Orlandi
Production: Seen Film
Distribution: Urban Sales

https://www.seenfilm.com
